E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Clown in the Dumps: Krusty loses confidence and retires from showbusiness after his father dies. Lisa frets about Homer's health. (S26 Ep1/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wreck of the Relationship: Homer and Bart take part in a father-son therapy exercise on a ship. While they're away, Marge gets involved in Homer's fantasy football league. (S26 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stakeout: Peralta and Boyle go on an eight-day stakeout, putting a strain on their friendship. Holt's nephew visits and makes an instant impression on Diaz. (S2 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Beach House: The team are excited about visiting Boyle's beach house for a detectives-only weekend getaway, until Peralta ruins the fun by inviting Captain Holt. (S2 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blindsided: The Dunphys and Pritchetts go head-to-head when Luke decides his best chance of getting into college is to run against Manny in the senior class president election. (S8 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Weathering Heights: Phil's excited when he's invited onto the local news. And his day gets even better when he meets his weatherman hero, Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion). (S8 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween 4: The Revenge of Rod Skyhook: Luke's Halloween party isn't going well. The Dunphys decide it needs a visit from Rod Skyhook, some promotion and adult supervision... (S8 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Grab It!: Jay's favourite place in the world may be losing some of its charm when Phil considers becoming a member. And Claire mistakes her influence on Alex's life choices. (S8 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Every Man's Dream: Homer and Marge have a trial separation and embark on new relationships when Homer is diagnosed with narcolepsy. (S27 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: 'Cue Detective: A celebrity chef challenges Homer to a barbecue cook-off, but before the contest can take place, Homer's secret weapon - his prized new barbecue grill - is stolen. (S27 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Puffless: Patty and Selma try to quit smoking. But when Selma relapses, an angry Patty moves in with Marge and Homer - much to Homer's dismay. Maggie befriends some animals. (S27 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween of Horror: Homer takes down his festive decorations after Lisa is traumatised by Halloween Horror Night at Krustyland. Marge takes Bart to a trick-or-treating party. (S27 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fed up with his family's feuding, Jack pleads with Beth. Leah throws a welcome home party for herself and Imran. And two residents get closer.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Adventures in Baby-Getting: Marge gets a new car that's perfect for a family of five - but what if she decides she wants a family of six!? (S24 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Big mistakes are piling up already. The guests bombard chef Josh with eccentric requests. And a deckhand makes a crazy decision with a jellyfish. (S10 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch The Great Celebrity Bake Off for SU2C, Race Across the World, Love Is Blind, The Dog Academy, Beef, Outlast and ITV News on criminal charges against Trump. (S21 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers have been watching Britain's Got Talent, Scared of the Dark, Obsession, Family Fortunes, Love Is Blind, Inside the Factory, and BBC News (nurses' strikes). (S21 Ep9)
